title: JEV priority layer: rank disasters by hazard x biodiversity x forest pressure
summary: Tell a partner which current disasters to look at first, instead of 400 equal markers.

costs.$comment: GBIF count and tile reads are keyless; infra is the extra function time.

outcomes.metric: Hours of daily triage saved per partner analyst
outcomes.$comment: ASSUMPTION: 4 analysts x 10 h/month of manual ranking avoided.

risks.title: A heuristic score is read as an official priority
risks.mitigation: Card shows the three factors and says 'heuristic'; weights live in jev/priority.json.

risks.title: Per-event GBIF count lookups slow the function or hit GBIF limits
risks.mitigation: Max 60 events, 6 concurrent, 8 s timeout, 24 h lookup cache, 30 min result cache.

conditions: Review weights with at least one partner before month 3; record the agreed weights in src/jev/priority.js.
